name: Button
intent: CTA / secondary / icon button。3階層ヒエラルキー。

contained.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-primary-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

outlined.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

brand-outline.description: ブランド色のアウトライン。Contained の次に強いセカンダリ（フォロー/状態トグル等）。slate の outlined より主張が強い
brand-outline.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium text-primary-500 bg-white border border-primary-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

neutral.description: ニュートラル（同スタイル並列配置 OK）
neutral.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer

lighted.description: ライテッド（Neutralとペアで使用）
lighted.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-primary-50 text-primary-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer

danger.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

subtle.description: 最小限の視覚的存在感
subtle.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium text-slate-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

small.tailwind: h-8 px-3 text-[0.875rem] relative after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:top-1/2 after:h-11 after:-translate-y-1/2

medium.tailwind: h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] relative after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:top-1/2 after:h-11 after:-translate-y-1/2

platformSemantics.hover: web のみ。app には hover が存在せず pressed が対応する（recipes/app の pressedStyle が写像先）
platformSemantics.elevation: web は box-shadow、app は iOS shadow* + Android elevation に分解される。トークン（elevation.*）は共有
platformSemantics.touchTarget: app はタッチターゲット最小 44pt を size 側で保証する。web も after: 擬似要素拡張で実効タップ領域 44px を保証する（見た目の高さは h-8/h-10 のまま。BTN_MIN_TAP_TARGET が検知）。縦積みで gap-2（8px）以下の隣接は判定が重なるため拡張を外してよい（DOM 後勝ち）。icon-only は幅拡張が別式のため第一弾対象外
platformSemantics.focus: web は focus ring クラス、app は FocusRing overlay コンポーネント（キーボード/TV フォーカス時）

disabled.description: 操作不可。全 variant 共通。
disabled.ariaChanges: disabled 属性 + aria-disabled="true"。hover/focus は効かせない。

loading.description: 非同期処理中。全 variant 共通。
loading.htmlNote: label 前にスピナーを prepend（スピナーのクラスは htmlSample/anatomy 側で表現。htmlNote は prose でリンタ非対象）。

htmlSample.contained: <button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-primary-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer relative after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:top-1/2 after:h-11 after:-translate-y-1/2">保存</button>
htmlSample.outlined: <button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer relative after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:top-1/2 after:h-11 after:-translate-y-1/2">キャンセル</button>
htmlSample.brand-outline: <button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4 text-[1rem] font-medium text-primary-500 bg-white border border-primary-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-primary-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer relative after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:top-1/2 after:h-11 after:-translate-y-1/2">フォロー</button>
